title: [Email - SMTP Connector] Fix OAuth Base64URL token parsing
summary: OAuth2 SMTP authentication now correctly decodes Base64URL tokens by normalizing them to standard Base64 before parsing, fixing intermittent authentication failures when JWT payloads contain URL-safe characters.
key_points: Base64URL tokens are converted to standard Base64 format before decoding
Fixes authentication failures when JWT payload contains '-' or '_' characters
Regression test added to cover Base64URL-specific characters
Existing username extraction and authentication flow unchanged
Resolves issue where standard Base64 decoder raised invalid encoding errors
quote: Normalize the OAuth access-token payload from Base64URL to standard Base64 before decoding it.
